prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: pixel-art paper illustration, preview for a research website.
Primary request: one compact pixel-art illustration representing character-training side effects and their mitigation together.
Subject: a terracotta pot with a plant whose two intertwined green branches visibly share the same stem. One branch carries a healthy gold flower, representing the intended trained trait. The other branch has distinct muted-purple thorns, representing an unwanted correlated trait. Small steel pruning shears with dark green handles are positioned at the thorny branch, selectively snipping a thorn-bearing twig without touching the flowering branch. One tiny clipped thorny twig is falling beside the pot. Several purple thorns remain on the plant: mitigation is partial, not perfect. No hands or people.
Composition: single clear centered sprite, slight three-quarter view, generous blank margin. Flower and shears both clearly legible; keep the composition compact enough to recognize at 96 pixels. The shears must visibly target only the thorny branch. One pot, one flower, two main branches, one pair of shears.
Style: authentic crisp pixel art, deliberately visible square pixels, stepped edges, restrained 32-bit adventure-game inventory illustration. Match a warm scholarly website; charming but not a cartoon face. Flat limited palette with a little pixel shading. Forest green #344b49, warm cream #fff2d8, terracotta, gold, muted purple, and steel gray.
Backdrop: solid pure white, no ground shadows, no gradients. Background will be removed for use on cream and dark pages.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no charts, no frame, no watermark, no extra equipment, no multiple panels. Do not show the whole plant cut down or the flower damaged. Avoid smooth vector curves or photorealism.
processing: White background removed; cropped and nearest-neighbor resized onto transparent 512px square.
